summary: Round 2 E2E test (backend + frontend). New pytest file test_tradewise_round2.py has 20 tests and all pass. They cover: watchlist CRUD, 409 on duplicate, invalid ticker, above/below 422 validation, clear level, separate US list, watchlist shown first in Today reviewing, 404s; alerts created exactly once for a long target and a short stop, mark seen; calendar shape for ASX and US; channels (tokens false, Discord and TG-bot 422, invalid and non-existent handle 422, connect public 'durov', sync, toggle, delete, 404 after delete); paste parser. Regression suites test_tradewise_api.py and test_tradewise_extra.py: 29/29 pass after one test was updated, because a future published_at now returns 422, which is accepted behaviour. UI checks that passed: the Today watchlist add, duplicate, invalid and level toasts, levels persisting on blur, remove, and the US list with an AAPL earnings event shown in the calendar; calendar-panel; the alerts bell count, the panel list, the browser-notify-toggle, and the count clearing after close; how-it-works-link going to /learn#guide with the guide visible and 10 guide-item accordions; channels-section (token-needed + Connect disabled for Discord/TG bot, error toasts, connect durov, Check now, the active toggle, delete); the paste parser; and the Analyse, Trades, Follow and Learn pages loading with no page errors. Mobile 390px layout is OK. No critical bugs. Several minor issues are listed below.

minor.issue: No duplicate check. Connecting the same handle twice creates 2 channels that both sync. Because ext_key includes the channel id, the same messages get imported twice as duplicate setups. Return 409 when platform+mode+normalised handle already exists.

channels.telegram_public accepts 'https://t.me/durov' because it strips the URL internally. add_channel, however, stores the raw handle: source slug 'telegram-https://t.me/durov', url 'https://t.me/https://t.me/durov'. Normalise the handle (lstrip '@', take the last path segment) before building the Channel and the Source.

The Source document created on connect (feed_type Telegram/Discord) is never removed, so deleted channels stay in the Follow sources list. Also, re-connecting the same handle under a new display name reuses the old source (with the old name) via the slug.

Alerts referencing the deleted trade or watch item remain and still show in the bell (e.g. 'CBA · Practice trade hit target' after the trade was deleted). Delete the alerts by ref_id on delete, or filter them out in GET /alerts.

check_alerts reads the existing keys and then inserts. Two concurrent runs (manual check + 120s loop) can both insert the same key. The unique index then raises DuplicateKeyError, which gives a 500 or a logged loop error. Use update_one(..., upsert=True) with $setOnInsert, or catch DuplicateKeyError. This was not reproduced in 3 parallel calls; it is a code-level race.

Channel syncs run in a single try. A non-ChannelError (e.g. a Setup validation error or a parse exception) in one channel skips all the remaining channels for that cycle. Wrap each sync_channel in its own try.

When the crumb is refreshed, the old AsyncClient is never closed (leak). Concurrent company_events calls in asyncio.gather can each create their own client/crumb (the log shows multiple getcrumb calls).

Not a code bug. For ASX names, Yahoo only returns the last (past) earnings/ex-dividend dates (CBA 2026-08-11, WES 2026-08-26), so ASX users will almost always see 'No upcoming company event found'. Consider a note in the UI that ASX dates are only available close to reporting season.

ui_bugs.issue: After a rejected level (e.g. 'Rises to' 10 when the price is 76.69), the error toast shows but the invalid value stays in the input. The reload doesn't change `value` (null -> null), so the useEffect never resets it. Every later blur re-sends it and shows the same error again, and the user may think it was set. Reset v to value in the catch.

The `uppercase` class also uppercases the placeholder, so on mobile it shows 'ADD A ASX STOCK, E.G. WES' truncated. There's also a grammar slip: 'a ASX' should be 'an ASX'. Use placeholder:normal-case.
These calls have no try/catch, so a failed request (e.g. 404, network) gives an unhandled promise rejection with no toast.

integration_issues.issue: Shows alerts for trades and watch items that have already been deleted (backend orphan alerts).

issues: The 'Setups apply to' market field is a native <select>. Every other choice uses pill buttons or shadcn; consider a shadcn Select for consistency.

action_items: Return 409 on a duplicate channel connect, and normalise the Telegram handle (strip @ / t.me URL) before saving the channel and source
Delete the auto-created Source when its channel is deleted, or at least not leave orphan TEST/old sources
Delete or ignore alerts whose trade/watch item was deleted
Make the alert insert idempotent (upsert or catch DuplicateKeyError); wrap each channel sync in its own try in background_loop
Watchlist LevelInput: reset to the saved value after a 422
Minor: placeholder casing/grammar in watch-add-input; add try/catch + toasts for the watch remove and channel sync/delete/toggle calls; close the old httpx client in _yahoo_client
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1077 lines (well over 700). Split it into routers: market, analyse, follow/setups, channels, trades, watchlist/alerts, calendar, today
today(): mk.normalize(t, market) on trending symbols is still not wrapped in try/except (it carries over from iteration 1)
add_watch: the duplicate check runs after the Yahoo quote call; check the DB first to save the Yahoo call (rate limits)
PATCH /api/channels/{id} takes `active` as a query param rather than a JSON body (inconsistent with the other PATCH endpoints)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows work; minor LevelInput reset bug)

seed_data_creation: All test data was cleaned up: watchlist, trades and channels are empty. All alerts were deleted (only test alerts existed). TEST_* Telegram sources were removed directly in Mongo because there is no API for that.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (pytest.ini enables xdist). The system date is Sat 2026-10-31, both markets closed. ForexFactory economic is empty on weekends. ASX company events are past dates, so they're filtered out; US AAPL has earnings on 2026-11-02, which is useful for checking the calendar. Telegram public 'durov' works (last_message_id ~552, 0 setups imported since it has no tickers). A sonner toast disappears quickly, so wait on [data-sonner-toast] instead of using a fixed sleep. The alerts popover fades in, so wait ~1s before taking a screenshot.
rca of the issue: Orphan sources and duplicate channels: add_channel builds the slug from the raw body.handle and never checks db.channels for an existing handle; delete_channel only deletes the channel doc. LevelInput stale value: useEffect([value]) does not fire when the reloaded value is identical (null), so the local state keeps the rejected input.
